reason: I already paid a developer and a portal and got almost nothing back, so Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month to a small remote studio I have never met, with only one past client, is not something I will risk. My enquiries are manageable by hand right now.
objection: One chemical company website in 2026 is not proof. How do I know the quotes it drafts will be correct, and that you will still be around in a year when I am paying Rs 5,000 a month?
would_change_my_mind: Talking directly to that chemical-trading client and seeing the quote desk work on my own price list with my real IndiaMART enquiries before I pay more than a small amount.
